# PeptidePen

> PeptidePen sells a reusable needle-free injector and the PeptiCool™ active travel cooler for GLP-1 pens and vials. Prices are charged in USD; delivery is free.

The needle-free injector delivers through the skin with a fast, narrow stream instead of a needle. Each kit includes sterile single-use nozzles, vial and ampoule adapters, a reset tool, a carry case and a quick-start guide. It is a delivery device, not a medicine.

PeptiCool is a thermoelectric travel cooler that holds a set temperature (2–8°C) with a touchscreen readout and USB-C power, with no ice packs.
